place.name: Coo-Trois-Ponts Hydroelectric Power Station
place.description: The Coo-Trois-Ponts Hydroelectric Power Station is a pumped-storage hydroelectric power station in eastern Belgium, located near Coo in the valley of the Amblève, on the territory of Stavelot and Trois-Ponts in the Province of Liège. Operated by Electrabel, it is Belgium's principal large-scale electricity-storage facility and one of the largest pumped-storage installations in Europe.
